mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM ods_user_asset_exchange_record_diversion ouaerd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (ouaerd.user_id = dui.user_id) WHERE ouaerd.dates = #{dates}

SELECT duer.id, ouaerd.dates, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, ouaerd.from_type, ouaerd.from_amount, ouaerd.to_amount, ouaerd.to_type, ouaerd.create_time FROM ods_user_asset_exchange_record_diversion ouaerd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (ouaerd.user_id = dui.user_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_exchange_record duer on (duer.dates = ouaerd.dates and duer.user_id = dui.user_id and duer.pkg = dui.pkg and duer.country = dui.country) WHERE ouaerd.dates = #{dates} limit #{startRows}, #{rows}
